map.圆筒储罐按设计压力 p 与直径 d 求所需壁厚 t。: A cylindrical tank's required wall thickness t from design pressure p and diameter d.
map.气瓶（球壳）按 p 求壁厚，球壳两向应力相等更省料。: For a spherical vessel the wall thickness follows p, and the spherical shell has equal stress in both directions, which saves material.
map.管道环向应力主导，焊缝需 100% 探伤。: Pipe hoop stress governs, so welds need 100% inspection.
map.：圆筒 p=1 MPa、d=1000 mm、[σ]=140 MPa、焊接系数 φ: For a cylinder with p = 1 MPa, d = 1000 mm, [sigma] = 140 MPa and weld factor phi = 0.85: t = pd/(2[sigma]phi) = 1x1000/(2x140x0.85) = 4.2 mm, then add the corrosion allowance.

map.为什么环向应力是轴向两倍？: Why Is the Hoop Stress Twice the Axial One?
map.环向 σθ=pd/2t 平衡内压径向分力，轴向 σa=pd/4t 仅端部封头传递: The hoop stress sigma_theta = pd/2t balances the radial component of internal pressure, while the axial stress sigma_a = pd/4t is carried only by the end caps, so the hoop direction is more dangerous and needs priority control.
map.t/d>0.1 用拉美公式 σθ=r_i²·p/(r_o²−r_i²)·(r_o: For t/d > 0.1 use the Lamé formula sigma_theta = ri^2*p/(ro^2 - ri^2)*(ro^2/r^2 + 1), where the inner wall stress is the largest.
